name: ciclo
description: Treino, dieta e vida administrados pelo Claude (MCP) — semana flexível, uso no celular, R$ 0.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/web && npm run cf:types -w @ciclo/worker && tsc -p apps/worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && node scripts/predeploy.mjs --static && npm run deploy:dry -w @ciclo/worker
scripts.deploy: node scripts/predeploy.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/predeploy.mjs --with-build && npm run db:migrate:remote -w @ciclo/worker && npm run deploy -w @ciclo/worker
